name: Philia Kartner
original_name: フィリア・カートナー
source:
“I want to be someone who can wipe away the tears of everyone.”

Raised without ever knowing her true identity as the Holy Maiden, Philia grew up as an ordinary girl. Her appearance is delicate and almost ephemeral, but within her lies an unyielding strength of spirit.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]
